name: Zendrop
summary: AI dropshipping and print-on-demand for Shopify: browse 1M+ products from US and global suppliers, link them to your store and let fulfilment and tracking run automatically, with custom branding, POD and 3PL as you scale.
best_for: Shopify merchants starting or scaling a dropshipping or print-on-demand store who want sourcing, automated fulfilment, tracking and custom branding in one app, and who can price the per-order product and shipping cost into their margins
skip_if: you already have supplier relationships worth keeping, or you need the cheapest possible international shipping — the vetted US supplier network is the selling point here and you pay for it
honest_knock: The free plan is a catalogue browser rather than a working tier: it allows no linked products, so nothing can actually be sold through it. Past that you are paying for an allowance, not for capability — Beginner, Pro and Plus carry exactly the same feature list, and the only thing $79 buys over $29 is room for more than a hundred linked products. The subscription is also the smaller half of the bill: product and shipping cost lands per order on top, and Zendrop bills that separately from your Shopify invoice, so the figure you budget is not the figure you pay. Their own pricing page and the App Store listing do not agree: the site sells Free, Pro and Plus with annual rates and no $29 tier, which means the price depends on where you sign up. And the 4.5 average covers a split verdict, with 83% five stars alongside 7% one star across 1,264 reviews (read 5 October 2026) — 86 people rating it bottom of the scale.

pricing.notes: (re-read 2026-09-18 and again on 2026-10-05 on apps.shopify.com/zendrop and on zendrop.com/pricing — the two do not carry the same ladder) On the Shopify listing: free to install, with three paid tiers, Beginner $29, Pro $49 and Plus $79 a month. What separates them is not features but how many products you may link to your store. The free tier allows none at all (“No linked products allowed”), Beginner covers 1-20, Pro 21-100 and Plus 101 or more; the feature list on all three paid tiers is identical (trending products, Zendrop Academy, Zendrop AI access, custom branding). Product and shipping cost is charged per order on top of every plan, and the listing states that external charges may be billed by Zendrop separately from your Shopify invoice. All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days. Rating 4.5 from 1,264 App Store reviews on 5 October 2026, after 4.6 from 1,258 on 18 September and 4.5 from 1,191 on 19 August; the spread is 83% five-star (1.0K), 7% four-star (94), 1% three-star (18), 1% two-star (18) and 7% one-star (86). The listing does not carry Shopify's “Built for Shopify” badge. Developer Zendrop, 5499 North Federal Highway, Suite R, Boca Raton, FL, 33487, US; the app launched 4 November 2020. On zendrop.com/pricing the ladder is different: Free $0, Pro $49 a month or $399 a year, and Plus $79 a month or $549 a year, marked Most Popular. There is no $29 Beginner tier on their own site, and the annual rates appear only there — $399 is $33.25 a month and $549 is $45.75. The Summer Promo recorded here on 19 August 2026 (65% off annual Plus for the first year, advertised as a $357 saving, plus $100 in order credits, ending 31 August 2026) is gone: the page carries no percentage-off offer at all on 18 September or 5 October 2026. Their own site also lists products the App Store listing does not mention, including AI-Built Stores, an AI Ad Generator and an MCP Server for connecting AI agents to a store.

open_questions.question: Can a customer cancel at any time, and what happens to an annual plan that is cancelled mid-term?
Which data can a customer export, in which formats, on which plans?
Where is customer data stored, and can a customer choose the region?
Is there a minimum number of seats or users on any plan?

vendor_mcp.what: Server for their dropshipping platform: search the catalog, request shipping methods and delivery windows per country, list and filter orders with tracking, pull revenue, profit and refund analytics, and trigger fulfilment behind a built-in confirmation step. Access runs on a token you generate, can scope to read-only and can revoke.
vendor_mcp.plan: Their FAQ answers it directly: "Do I need a paid Zendrop plan to use the MCP server? You can get started free. Some features may require a paid plan depending on your store's volume and needs." No tier is named.
vendor_mcp.note: The vendor's own MCP server, from our MCP research; it works with your own account at the vendor.
